intent: Analyze system state baseline for Asus Vivobook Pro 15
detected_fault: Persistent FPS drop in games (110-120 to 17-20 FPS) after prolonged gaming sessions
suggested_solution: Run stress tests to monitor GPU temperatures and identify potential thermal issues.
Install G Helper to manage performance, fan speed, and clock speeds of the GPU.
Update GPU driver to latest version.
Investigate BIOS version and consider updating it to latest version.
